corrections: **RFI Savoirs no longer exists separately** — savoirs.rfi.fr redirects to francaisfacile.rfi.fr. Use the RFI français facile exercises in its place.
**RFI is a full graded course**, not just a podcast: exercises tagged A1 · A2 · B1 · B2 · C1/C2 — week 1 to C2, free.
**News in Slow French is now subscription.** Skippable — RFI's *Journal en français facile* does the same job free and daily.

sections.title: This week — the only four you need

items.name: French Today — Pronunciation & Audio Guide
items.note: **Start here.** Native Parisian audio: all 19 vowel sounds, the u, the R, nasals, liaison in one page. Your weeks 1–2 reference.

items.name: The Perfect French with Dylane — Master the French Nasal Vowels
items.note: Teaches **four** nasals; your syllabus says **three**. Produce three — *un* has merged into *in* for most speakers.

items.name: Forvo — French
items.note: Any single word, multiple native speakers. Use it the moment you're unsure, especially on new Anki cards.

items.name: Anki + 5000 most frequently used French words v6.0
items.note: Take the **Canadian French audio** variant. **Never hide the article field.** Ships a phonology sub-deck — a week-1 asset. ~30 new cards/day.

items.name: italki French tutors
items.note: Filter to **community tutors**, not professional teachers. *Teachers from* → Benin, Togo, Côte d'Ivoire, Cameroon: below European rates, your time zone. Tutor hours are the one thing worth paying for first.

items.name: Le Point du FLE
items.note: 17,100+ indexed links. Your grammar spine from week 2 — navigate by topic, not level.

items.name: Grammaire Progressive du Français (CLE International) — A2, then B1
items.note: Explanation left page, exercises right, answer key included. Check Alliance Française Lagos stock before ordering.

items.name: Kwiziq
items.note: Optional/skippable — Le Point du FLE + a marked-writing tutor finds your gaps for less.

items.name: Rung 1 · Coffee Break French — Season 1
items.note: Weeks 1–4. Your shadowing source: shadowing needs audio you already understand.

items.name: Rung 2 · Le français facile avec RFI
items.note: **Weeks 5 onward, and forever.** *Journal en français facile* daily + graded exercises A1→C1/C2 + *La puce à l'oreille*. The best free French resource that exists.

items.name: Rung 3 · Apprendre le français — TV5MONDE
items.note: Video + exercises by theme, and **the themes map onto the TCF themes**: Santé, Travail, Éducation, Médias, Logement… 14-question level test on the homepage. Also free TCF practice.

items.name: Rung 4 · InnerFrench (podcast)
items.note: B1–B2 pace with transcripts. The site sits behind a bot check — go via Spotify, Apple Podcasts or YouTube.

items.name: Rung 5 · HugoDécrypte (YouTube) · TV5Monde 7 jours sur la planète
items.note: Native speed, no concessions. The rung that gets you to 458.

items.name: Rung 1 · 1jour1actu
items.note: Written for French schoolchildren — which is why it lands at A2–B1 for an adult learner.

items.name: Rung 2 · RFI français facile — exercices (replaces RFI Savoirs)
items.note: Filter to B1, then B2.

items.name: Rung 3 · Le Monde
items.note: The free articles are enough. Real native press — what the later reading items actually are.

items.name: Exemples d'épreuves du TCF (official samples)
items.note: **The official sample papers.** Nothing else is as representative.

items.name: Manuel du candidat TCF (PDF, 3.4 MB)
items.note: **Read it before your first mock** — confirms current word counts and timings.

items.name: TCF Canada — official page
items.note: Structure, registration, results — and the re-marking notice.

items.name: Réussir le TCF Canada (Didier)
items.note: Full mocks with audio. The main paid prep book.

items.name: PrepMyFrench
items.note: Optional — official samples + Didier cover you.

items.name: Réussir TCF Canada
items.note: Free **methodology pages** for all four skills, **writing and speaking topics every month** (archive from 2022) with **free corrections**, and 2 free listening training series. Tests and simulators are paid (US5–200).

items.name: Formation TCF Canada
items.note: Listening **series 1–3 free** (39 questions each, account needed) plus tips. Series 4–6, the writing/speaking simulators and full mocks are paid (from US5).

items.name: KD Singh Academy — TCF drills
items.note: **Listening A1–C2 (905 questions)** and **reading A1–C2 (898 questions)**, one at a time with the correction. The biggest free drill bank found.
items.warn: Its questions are advertised as **recalled from real exams**. Unofficial: practise the skill, don’t memorise answers — the real test won’t repeat them, and memorised scores hide your true level.

items.name: TCFcan
items.cost: Free level test; bank needs sign-up
items.note: A **free 10-question level test** (5 listening + 5 reading, explanations, no sign-up). The 1,600+ question bank needs a free account; paid tiers aren’t listed. Subtitles are French–Chinese.
items.warn: Its questions are advertised as **recalled from real exams**. Unofficial: practise the skill, don’t memorise answers — the real test won’t repeat them, and memorised scores hide your true level.

items.name: TCF TEF Prep — free placement check
items.note: **15 questions, ~15 min, no sign-up**: an estimated CLB level for listening and reading. One free demo mock with an account. Full mocks, drills and explanations are paid.

items.name: Lingua.com — French reading
items.note: **41 free graded texts A1–C1**, each with comprehension questions and instant correction. Good for daily reading before TCF-style items.

items.name: Lingua.com — French listening
items.note: Only **10 free audio texts** (A1–B2) with questions; the rest is premium. Use the free ones, don’t subscribe.

items.name: Frenchico (app)
items.note: AI speaking practice with scoring for TCF task 3. **Paid** after a 3-day trial — not needed: the Speaking page and a tutor cover this.

items.name: Alliance Française Lagos — calendar portal
items.note: Calendar is behind a login (create your own account). certification.lagos@afnigeria.org · +234 705 22 88 001. **No postponement or refund once registered.**

items.name: Alliance Française Port Harcourt
items.note: Public calendar (2026 only as of Sep). reception.phc@af-nigeria.org · +234 706 253 4631. Pattern: monthly sessions, registration closes 4–5 weeks before; 2027 calendar ~Nov–Dec.
